source.name: MLB.com press release (archived): Seattle Mariners expand relationship with Nintendo with team's first-ever jersey sleeve partnership
source.quote: Nintendo of America Inc. has expanded upon their long-standing relationship with the club, becoming the team's first-ever official jersey sleeve partner.
source.note: The club's own fan page (archived 2026-04-10, https://web.archive.org/web/20260410154045/https://www.mlb.com/mariners/fans/nintendo) says the racetrack logo is on home jerseys and the Switch 2 logo on away jerseys. Blinkfire's 2026 MLB jersey patch list (2026-04-20) names 'Seattle Mariners – Nintendo'; no other patch sponsor is listed for the club.

summary: Jersey sleeve patch: Nintendo (Nintendo of America). The home jersey carries the Nintendo racetrack logo, the road jersey the Nintendo Switch 2 logo.
